state.observerPolicy: Independent screenshot-only observer. Expectations identify the promised UI, not an answer. No readiness, mastery, cryptographic identity, transport behavior or action authorization is inferred from pixels.

minimax_readonly.expectation: The selected existing local capability returns a source-labelled read-only briefing with current learner state and next tutor move. It must state it cannot grant mastery or write canonical learner state. This is not evidence that fourteen tutor agents or a tutor cycle ran.
